dimensions.evidenceA: John answers a direct question about whether he is Elijah.
dimensions.evidenceB: Jesus describes John through the expected Elijah role.
dimensions.label: Question and answer

dimensions.evidenceA: John speaks to priests and Levites sent from Jerusalem.
dimensions.evidenceB: Jesus speaks to crowds after John’s messengers leave.
dimensions.label: Speaker and audience

evidence.observation: When delegates ask whether he is Elijah, John says, “I am not.”
Jesus says that John is Elijah who is to come, if the hearers are willing to receive it.

record.tension: John denies that he is Elijah, while Jesus describes him through the Elijah who is to come.
record.title: Is John Elijah?
